text:
holy sh*t, you can just let AI drive your browser now

Browser Use: give it a task, it opens Chrome, reads the page, clicks, types, and finishes the job

→ works with GPT, Claude, Gemini or local models
→ 119K+ GitHub stars
→ 100% free and open source

github.com/browser-use/browser-use

holy sh*t, you can run ChatGPT-class models on your laptop for free

Ollama: one command, and DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, Gemma or gpt-oss are running locally — offline, private, yours

→ works on Mac, Linux, Windows
→ 185K+ GitHub stars
→ 100% free and open source

github.com/ollama/ollama

holy sh*t, your AI agents can now scrape the entire web like it's an API

Firecrawl: turn any website into clean LLM-ready markdown, JSON or screenshots — built for agents, RAG and research

→ crawl / scrape / map / extract in one SDK
→ 199K+ GitHub stars
→ open source, self-host or cloud

github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl

holy sh*t, you can now hire an entire AI software company with ONE prompt

MetaGPT gives you a PM, architect, project manager and engineers, all AI agents, each doing one job and handing off like a real team

→ one line in, PRD + design + tasks + code out
→ 71K+ GitHub stars
→ 100% open source (MIT)

github.com/FoundationAgents/MetaGPT

holy sh*t, your AI agent finally stops forgetting you

Mem0 is a drop-in memory layer: it pulls the facts out of every chat, stores them, and recalls the right ones next session

→ add() + search(), a few lines of Python
→ works with OpenAI, Claude, and local LLMs
→ 68K+ GitHub stars
→ 100% open source (Apache-2.0)

github.com/mem0ai/mem0

holy sh*t, you can stop coding AI agents from scratch

Dify lets you drag an LLM, your docs, and a few tools onto one canvas, then ship it as a live agent, web app, or API

→ RAG, agents, and workflows in one place
→ works with GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and Ollama
→ self-host with one docker command
→ 160K+ GitHub stars

github.com/langgenius/dify

this is f*cking wild, someone open-sourced an entire trading firm made of AI agents

TradingAgents gives one ticker to a full desk: analysts dig in, a bull and a bear argue it out, a trader makes the call, and a risk team has to sign off

→ fundamentals, sentiment, news, and technical analysts run in parallel
→ works with GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Ollama
→ backtests that only see data from that day
→ 121K+ GitHub stars

research only, not financial advice

github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents

holy f*ck, someone open-sourced an AI software engineer that ships the PR itself

OpenHands takes a GitHub issue, spins up a sandbox, reads your codebase, writes the fix, runs the tests, and opens the pull request

→ edits code, runs terminal commands, browses docs
→ everything runs sandboxed in Docker
→ works with Claude, GPT, Gemini, or local models
→ 93K+ GitHub stars, MIT-licensed core

assign the issue. go make coffee.

github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands

holy f*ck, people are still paying for Zapier when this is free on GitHub

n8n lets you drag-and-drop AI agents that actually run your business: a trigger fires, the agent thinks, the tools execute, and the job is done

→ native AI agent nodes with tools + memory
→ 400+ integrations (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Sheets...)
→ drop into JS/Python when nodes aren't enough
→ self-host it free with one docker command
→ 210K+ GitHub stars

build it once. it runs forever.

github.com/n8n-io/n8n

holy f*ck, people are still paying $20/month for ChatGPT when this is free on GitHub

Open WebUI gives you your own ChatGPT that runs on YOUR machine. pick a model, drop in your docs, ask anything, and nothing leaves your computer

→ works with Ollama (Llama, Qwen) or any OpenAI-compatible API
→ built-in RAG: chat with your PDFs and docs
→ web search, Python tools, voice + image gen
→ runs 100% offline, one docker command
→ 159K+ GitHub stars

own your AI. stop renting it.

github.com/open-webui/open-webui

holy f*ck, OpenAI charges $200/month for ChatGPT and this runs AI on your laptop for $0

llama.cpp is the engine behind basically every "run AI locally" app. one command, pick a model, and you've got your own AI with no API key and no bill

→ runs Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek
→ Mac, Windows, Linux, even phones
→ 4-bit quantization: big models on 8GB
→ OpenAI-compatible server for any app
→ 135K+ GitHub stars

wifi off. still works.

github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp

holy f*ck, half the faceless Shorts on your feed could be made by this free open-source repo from ONE topic

MoneyPrinterTurbo: type a topic, it writes the script, records the voiceover, pulls stock footage, adds subtitles + music, and renders a finished vertical video

→ YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Reels (9:16)
→ GPT, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek or local Ollama
→ batch-make variants in one run
→ WebUI, API or CLI
→ 145K+ GitHub stars

no camera. no editing. no face.

github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo

everyone's posting "I built a company inside AI" this week. this is the free open-source repo that actually does it

crewAI: give each AI agent a role, a goal and a backstory, then let the crew split the work, delegate and ship

→ researcher, analyst, writer, reviewer, manager
→ crews for autonomy, flows for control
→ GPT, Claude, Grok or local models
→ pure Python, no LangChain needed
→ 61K+ GitHub stars

you manage. they work.
